name: Roasted Red Peppers
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as red peppers are low FODMAP. Choose versions without added garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Check labels for added garlic or onion powder in jarred versions
Rinse jarred peppers to reduce sodium content
Roast your own by charring over open flame or under broiler
Store homemade roasted peppers in olive oil in refrigerator
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
Good source of vitamin A and beta-carotene
Low in calories and naturally fat-free
